Select activities.met_conversion, activities.pathway_key, activities.enzyme_name, assays.assay_organism, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS substrate_compound_name, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS parent_compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles
From metabolism
Left Join activities On metabolism.met_id = activities.activity_id
Left Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Left Join compound_records On activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
Left Join molecule_dictionary On compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Left Join molecule_hierarchy On molecule_dictionary.molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno
Left Join molecule_dictionary AS parent_mol On molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = parent_mol.molregno
Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Macaca fascicularis'
Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Limit 200
